# Garden water evidence register

Investigation number 001 · Garden water  
Working example for Next Time. Each entry preserves a statement made in the garden conversation. The statement supplies a possible water transfer. No dated field observation accompanies it. Source tier, qualification and classification below refer to the claimed physical transfer in this garden.

The direct links point to numbered entries in the Next Time working copy. The original conversation has no public source link in this register. The date logged records preparation of this register. The original capture date is unavailable.

## Snapshot 003 · Follow-up to the garden example

Date logged: 2026-11-16. The preceding snapshot is reproduced in full. The two records below are facts supplied for the example. The 36 numbered descriptions above concern possible water transfers.

### Context item 001 · Household

> A household was found.

Source: the person supplying the Next Time garden case, in a follow-up to the two numbered lists. [Public case wording](https://mayhem82.github.io/next-time/gateways/investigation.html#household-report).

Qualification: household discovery is established for the example. The statement supplies no account of the household moving water or experiencing harm. No field time, independent physical verification or numerical factual-strength assessment was supplied.

### Context item 002 · Puddle location

> The puddle is in the yard.

Source: the same case contributor, in the subsequent location statement. [Public case wording](https://mayhem82.github.io/next-time/gateways/investigation.html#yard-report).

Qualification: the original garden puddle is in the yard. The statement supplies a location. It records no water moving and no dated field measurement. No numerical factual-strength assessment was supplied.

### Correction · Scope of the follow-up

The earlier public summary added an inquiry into yard ownership. The investigator withdrew that inquiry on 2026-11-16 because the supplied findings did not raise it. The two statements above remain as reported. [Earlier published wording](https://github.com/mayhem82/next-time/blob/2b77ed906d19d8f7144ecf7f746bb39f3e888295/dist/gateways/investigation.html#L61-L66).
